chapter.verse: Shinar kumpipa Amrafel, Ellasar kumpipa Ariok, Elam kumpipa Khedorla-omer, Goi-im kumpipa Tidalte’ hun lai-in,
hih kumpite in Sodom kumpipa Bera, Gomorrah kumpipa Birsha, Admah kumpipa Shinab, Zeboi-im kumpipa Shemeber leh Bela (Zoar) kumpipa ahi kumpi ngate va sim uh hi.
Hih kumpi ngate in kipawlna bawlin Siddim Kuam (Ci Tuipi)—ah a thahatna uh gawm hi.
Amaute in kum sawm-le-nih sung Khedorla-omer’ khut nuai-ah om uh a, ahih hangin a kum sawm-le-thumna ciangin amaute in lehdo uh hi.
A kum sawm-le-li-na ciangin Khedorla-omer leh amah tawh a kipawl kumpite hong pai-in gamlak gamgi Elparan ciang dongah Ashteroth-Karnaim gam-a Refaim, Hamgam-a Zuzim, Shavehkiriathain gam-a Emin,
leh amau’ gam Seir Mual tunga Hori mite sehnel gamgei a, om El-paran dong hong zo uh hi;
tua ciangin amaute kihei kikin Enmishpat (Kadesh) ah hong pai uh a, Amalek mite’ gam khempeuhleh Hazazontamar gam-a a teng Amor mite zong zo uh hi.
Tua ciangin Sodom kumpipa, Gomorrah kumpipa, Admah kumpipa, Zeboi-im kumpipa leh Bela (Zoar) kumpipa kuankhia uh a, amaute kipawlin Siddim Kuam-ah
Elam kumpipa Khedorla-omer, Goi-im kumpipa Tidal, Shinar kumpipa Amrafel leh Ellaser kumpipa Ariok tawh kido uh hi, kumpi li kigawm leh kumpi nga kigawm kido uh hi.
Tu-in Siddim Kuam in kultal khukte tawh kidim hi; Sodom leh Gomorrah kumpite a tai uh ciangin pawl khat tua khukte sungah kia uh a, a om lai teng mual tungah tai uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin galte in Sodom leh Gommorahte’ na khempeuh leh a an khempeuh uh la-in ciah uh hi;
amaute in Sodom-a a teng Abram’ sanggampa’ tapa Lot leh ama na khempeuh zong la uh a, pai khia uh hi.

Tua ciangin a suakta mi khat hong pai-in, Hebru mi Abram’ kiangah hong gen hi. Amah pen Eshkol leh Aner’ sanggampa ahi hi. Amor mi hi a, Mamre’ tawsawte gei-ah teng hi; hih mite pen Abram’ kipawlpihte ahi hi.
Ama’ behpa sal-in a kimatna Abram in a zak ciangin, ama inn sunga a suak, a kihilhsa ama' mi zathum leh sawm-le-giatte makaihin Dan ciang dong a delhin pai uh hi.
Amah in amaute do dingin zan hunin ama' pawlte, amah leh a nasemte khenin amaute zo a, Damaskas leilu lam Hobah ciang dong delh uh hi.
Tua ciangin amah in na khempeuh, Lot leh ama na khempeuh, numeite leh mihingte ngahkikin ciahpih hi.
Abram in Khedorla-omer kumpipa leh a pawlte a zawhna panin a ciahkik ciangin Sodom kumpipa in amah dawn dingin Shaveh Kuam (Kumpipa’ Kuam)-ah na pai hi.
Tua ciangin Salem kumpipa Melkhizedek in an leh leenggahzu hong pusuah hi; amah in Sang Pen Pasian’ siampi zong ahi hi.
Amah in Abram thupha pia a, “Vantung leh leitung a bawl, Sang Pen Pasian in Abram thupha pia hen;
na galte na khut sungah a hong pia, Sang Pen Pasian in thupha ngah hen!” ci hi. Abram in na khempeuh seh-sawm-suah-seh-khat ama' tungah pia hi.
Sodom kumpipa in Abram kiangah, “A mite hong pia in la, ahih hangin a nate nang adingin la in,” ci hi.
Ahih hangin Abram in Sodom kumpipa' kiangah, “Vantung leh leitung a bawl, Sang Pen Topa Pasian' tungah ka kiciam khin zo hi,
nangmah in, ‘Abram ka hausak hi,’ ci kha ding na hih manin mimkhau ahi a, khedap khau ahi a, nangma’ aa ahi na khatpeuh peuh ahi zongin ka la kei ding hi.
Tangvalte’ neksakte leh kei tawh hong kuan mite’ tanh dingte lo buang bangmah ka la kei ding hi; Aner, Eshkol leh Mamre-te amau’ tanh ding la sak in,” ci hi.
